_comment: Screenshot manifest for the website and guide. kind=harness: 'shot' = ShotOpts for scripts/lib/harness.ts shot(); kind=copy: copies 'source'. Run `npm run site:shots -- --only id1,id2|--missing`, then `npm run site:build`.

shots.alt: A busy ski village in winter sunshine, lifts climbing the slopes behind the lodge.
shots.caption: Winter: lifts, pistes and a village that is getting busy.

shots.alt: The same valley in spring: blossom in the meadows, thin snow on the high slopes.
shots.caption: Spring: skiing up high, hiking down low.

shots.alt: A green summer valley with the village, hiking trails and meadows.
shots.caption: Summer: the snow is gone, the hikers and bikers arrive.

shots.alt: Autumn colours on the larger trees around the village.
shots.caption: Autumn: golden trees and a quiet breath before the snow.

shots.alt: The village at night with warm lit windows and lamp posts.
shots.caption: After dark the windows light up.

shots.alt: Skiers and snowboarders in colourful jackets streaming down a groomed slope.
shots.caption: Guests come in all shapes: skiers, boarders, families, hikers.

shots.alt: First-person view from a skier going down the slope, other guests ahead.
shots.caption: Ride along with any guest, from the lift to the bottom of the run.

shots.alt: Looking out from a chairlift seat over the valley and the cable.
shots.caption: Chairlift POV.

shots.alt: First-person walk in front of the base lodge.
shots.caption: Walk mode: stroll through your own resort.

shots.alt: Photo mode with a warm filter and a decorative frame around a dusk scene.
shots.caption: Photo mode: filters, frames and golden hour, saved locally as a PNG.

shots.alt: The main screen: top bar with money, rating and time; goals card on the right; the dock at the bottom.
shots.caption: The whole screen: top bar, goals card, dock.

shots.alt: The Buildings drawer open with category tabs and building cards with prices.
shots.caption: The Buildings drawer: tabs, prices and a season tag on each card.

shots.alt: The Lifts drawer showing the lift types, some locked in Career mode.
shots.caption: Lifts: eleven types, from T-bar to funicular.

shots.alt: The Pistes drawer with difficulty colours and grooming tools.
shots.caption: Paint pistes by colour; the game checks that they connect.

shots.alt: The Finance drawer with the money overview and tabs.
shots.caption: Finance: income, expenses, loans and reports.

shots.alt: The Pricing drawer with day pass and food price sliders.
shots.caption: Pricing: the game tells you if a price is cheap or expensive.

shots.alt: The Marketing drawer listing campaigns and their requirements.
shots.caption: Marketing campaigns and what each one needs.

shots.alt: The Operations drawer with staff and safety coverage.
shots.caption: Operations: staff, coverage and the safety picture.

shots.alt: The Career HUD: top bar, a level badge on the goals card and the dock along the bottom.
shots.caption: Career: the goals card carries your level badge; click it for the next level's requirements.

shots.alt: A level-up celebration banner over the resort.
shots.caption: Levelling up unlocks bigger lifts and buildings.

shots.alt: The scenario picker with six scenario cards and star difficulty.
shots.caption: Six scenarios, from a gentle valley to the Alpine Giant.

shots.alt: The New Game dialog with Career and Sandbox, map size and season.
shots.caption: New game: Career or Sandbox, map size, season, difficulty.

shots.alt: The Resort of the Year report with charts and awards.
shots.caption: Every in-game year ends with a report card (shown with demo numbers here).

shots.alt: The trophy shelf with achievements and cosmetic rewards.
shots.caption: The trophy shelf.

shots.alt: The settings dialog with sound, feedback intensity, text size and reduced motion.
shots.caption: Settings: sound, feedback, text size, reduced motion and more.

shots.alt: The help dialog listing keyboard shortcuts.
shots.caption: Press ? or H anywhere for the shortcut list.

shots.alt: The Save and Load dialog with slots and export buttons.
shots.caption: Save / Load: slots, quicksave and .slope export.

shots.alt: The pause menu with Resume, Save, Load, Settings, Help.
shots.caption: Esc opens the pause menu when nothing else is open.

shots.alt: The main menu with Continue, New game, Scenarios, Trophies and a live village behind it.
shots.caption: The title screen, with a live demo village behind the menu.

shots.alt: A brown bear on a meadow path with an orange threat overlay glowing around it, close to the village.
shots.caption: A bear in the woods. Rangers keep guests and bears apart.

shots.alt: A contact sheet of ten different generated resort towns.
shots.caption: Ten demo towns, all generated from a seed.
